mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4% signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates and enhancing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-positive 20d returns in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 4% for the prior 3 months, or the 20d returns are not statistically significantly higher than a baseline (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% triggers increased consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 3.5%, or returns remain negative despite sustained rate decline below threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust demand-side expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both GDPC1 and RSAFS are rising concurrently, or the interaction effect rank IC <0.05 over a 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a surge in industrial production (INDPRO) above 102.0 (2017=100) indicates excess supply, prompting market expectations of inflation normalization and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when in late-cycle expansion regime but INDPRO exceeds 102.0, or returns remain negative despite high INDPRO in such regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate above 4% triggers a sell-off in risk assets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly negative (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0%, or returns remain positive despite high FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A convergence of falling unemployment (UNRATE) below 3.0% and rising employment (PAYEMS) above 1.5 million triggers increased consumer spending and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both UNRATE <3.0 and PAYEMS >1.5M, or the interaction effect rank IC <0.1 over a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trajectory in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 4-quarter moving average signals robust economic momentum, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when GDPC1 is above its 4-quarter moving average, or the returns remain negative despite sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: An abrupt surge in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 102.0 (2017=100) signals excess supply, prompting market expectations of inflation normalization and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when INDPRO crosses above 102.0, or returns remain negative despite the surge.
